reviews.text: Cowtown Pool built our pool to our satisfaction and did a great job. Ace and his crew were very professional and thorough. We are extremely happy with our own little tropical oasis.
reviews.author: Don Rogers

reviews.text:
Cowtown pools is a family, owner-operated company.  We found Ace and Madeline very easy to work with.  They were very pleasant and genuinely nice people.  They were very good at answering all our silly questions and addressing any concerns he had.  At no point did they try and up-sell us or suggest things we didn't need.  They were only interested in building the pool we wanted.   (Our build was actually in summer 2017 even though I am posting this in summer 2018.)

Ace explained the entire process from start to finish before they began and was very clear about what our responsibilities were and what were his.  He was here almost every day of the build and supervised the process closely answering my questions as we went along.  The process was really fascinating to watch as I was there most days as well.

His subs were friendly and courteous and when problems arose Ace remained calm and handled it; he consulted with us when necessary.  He kept us continuously updated throughout the process and was very focused on making sure we were happy often saying. "I'll do it however you want it" in regards to options and changes.

Our pool is on the smaller side with a water feature, tanning ledge, underwater bench and 700 sq ft of concrete deck with the Texas star etched in.  They installed 2 drains on the deck and several umbrella holders around the pool edge and an LED color changing light.

I got lots of compliments on my pool and am the envy of my neighbors now thanks to Cowtown.

One last note: Cowtown's service guys are very friendly and easy to work with as well.  I had to call for one minor issue and they responded within a day or two and fixed the issue.  At first we used their weekly pool service since we are newbie pool owners and as I got more comfortable I now do my own weekly pool service but they are only a phone call away if I have questions.

Salt of the earth kind of people and company.  Honest and reliable.
reviews.author: BLACKMONGOOSE13

reviews.text: AWESOME!  I could not be more pleased with the work that Cowtown did on my pool.  I had the tile and coping replaced.  They were profession, experienced, reasonably priced and got the work done in 3 days!  Family owned and super people to work with.  Attached is a photo before, with the tile falling off and then a few photos after.  So happy!
reviews.author: Kell S

reviews.text:
Cowtown replaced all our pool equipment
after the deep freeze of 2021 so summer of 22. We have had nothing but trouble including leaks around seals and threads.
When the Polaris PB4sq pump went out 4+ weeks ago I made an appointment to have it replaced. They no called no showed, and have ignored every call since. Absolutely 0 customer service after we spent over $25,000 with them. Would give them 0 if I could.
reviews.author: Rebecca Bryant

reviews.text:
New Review (2024):

Thanks to Cowtown Pools for making a tanning ledge specially for my dog Hurley. They updated my pool and made it usable for my family. Cowtown Pools are my first call when I need help with my pool and they always get back with me as soon as they are able.

Old Review (2023):

I had a great experience with a home warranty claim with this company… I even called them out later for a one time service for cleaning filter. They are easy to communicate with. Seem genuine to me.
reviews.author: T T

reviews.text:
American Home Shield sent Cowtown pools out to diagnose my pool pump issue. Cowtown claimed “cracked back plate causing leak”, and claimed  “cracked impeller causing pump not to run and circulate water” stating that this is “not ordinary wear and tear” causing AHS to deny the claim for repair due to negligence on my part. My pump was not disassembled during this “diagnosis”, which would have immediately shown just how simple an issue this was. Instead, assumptions were made and I’m completely certain I’ve discovered why,

I disassembled the pump, which Cowtown Pools had worked on, on 2 previous service calls and found that the diffuser had simply fallen off the impeller plate due to a sheetrock screw being used to secure it, and it rusting out, while the second screw was missing altogether. They would have had to remove this diffuser to replace the motor on their previous visit. There is no doubt, Cowtown Pools is responsible for the Sheetrock screw and its subsequent failure.

Nothing was cracked, leaking, or even broken for that matter unless you want to count the sheetrock screw. I put two .30 cent stainless screws in the diffuser, lubed o-rings, and reassembled. The pump is now working flawlessly. Their quote for replacing parts that weren’t broken: $525 + $125 for the AHS service call = $650 .

I would have aired this grievance privately but my voicemail was never returned and now their line is stating it is disconnected when I call.

Post response edit: They still haven’t called me. The basket issue they mention was caused by the diffuser coming free and shooting forward into the pump basket, destroying it. The damage didn’t originate from any basket issue as they suggest. I’ve added another photo to show the diffuser blocking the pump basket from seating. Cowtown Pools diagnosed a symptom as the cause and as a result of that negligence we’re going to charge a customer hundreds of dollars throwing parts at a problem that was fixed in 10 minutes for .60 cents. As for “janky repairs”, you can’t replace the pump housing without totally and completely exposing the diffuser and seeing a sheetrock screw hanging out of it.

I’ve attached a photo of my pool pump which is quite obviously not old, but you already knew that.

And my favorite: “No matter how handy people think they are, they are likely not a pool professional, making it harder for them to see all repairs that may need to be made.”

Cowtown Pools did not disassemble the pump during this “diagnostic”, I’d think that would “make it harder for them to see” and also explain why I did see upon disassembly, a rusty sheetrock screw and a diffuser plate that simply required 2 new screws to properly secure it back in place.

None of the parts reported or quoted were broken, cracked, or leaking. None. I would know, I’m the only one that disassembled and looked at every component individually and thoroughly.

Post response edit #2: Cowtown Pools has now deleted their previous response. That certainly is telling.

If I’ve made false claims and Cowtown Pools has photos, they should definitely post those. Show me where those cracks and broken impeller are.

I never made an argument that AHS covers anything. Cowtown Pool’s misdiagnosis is the entire crux of the issue. Nothing Cowtown Pools stated as broken, was actually broken.

“Ahs also will not allow us to speak with argumentative customers , we are only allowed to direct them straight to AHS.”

AHS literally told me to call Cowtown Pools to discuss the issue directly.

The pump housing Cowtown has admitted to replacing cannot be replaced without totally and completely exposing the diffuser and the “hardware” (sheetrock screws) “securing” it to the impeller plate. I’m not a pool professional as you’ve previously pointed out, but I do have eyes.

I’ll happily delete this review once Cowtown posts pictures of the cracked impeller and cracked back plate they diagnosed as the issue. Too easy, right?

Photo of “diagnostic” invoice attached below.
reviews.author: TOOTHPICKPIMPIN

reviews.text: If you want your pool to look disgusting and dirty by all means use this awful company. I gave them multiple chances because they gave me excuses every time (owner had a stroke, it was windy, they hired a new guy, there were dog toys in their way) and still absolute garbage. My pool looks terrible AND I have a vacuum doing most the work. Those are 3 different occurrences.
reviews.author: Ashley Anastasia-Dominguez

reviews.text: We love Cowtown Pools! We have worked with them for about 7 years now. Cowtown did an incredible job refinishing our pool with quartz in 2018, and have serviced (or replaced) our equipment several times. They are reliable and their prices are extremely fair. The customer service from this family owned business is top-notch! We highly recommend Cowtown Pools.
reviews.author: Amber Cramer

reviews.text: Paid 8500 for pool resurfacing. Poor workmanship is all I have to say. I wouldn’t recommend them to my worst enemy.
reviews.author: John Morelli

reviews.text: Built our pool in 2011, Cowtown has serviced it nonstop since day one. Over 13 years with the same company proves they are 5 stars. There are many pool companies to chose from. We have never felt the need to look elsewhere. Service and pricing are outstanding. There have been ups and a few downs, but Ace and Maddy have always gone above and beyond to take care of us. They took exceptional care of us during snowmaggedon and several "emergency" situations where we needed additional service for unexpected equipment failure and other times where we needed pool service for surprise get togethers. They are a family owned business and when you call you get family. I highly recommend Cowtown, not only for maintenance but for repairs as well.
reviews.author: R Walton

reviews.text:
If your home warranty company wants to send out Cowtown pools call them back and request a different provider.

I contacted One Guard Home Warranty about my freeze sensor on my pool. They sent Cowtown Pools out with a service call. Cowtown Pools did not look at the Freeze sensor. My wife made sure to mention the freeze sensor to the tech when he was here looking at the pool. Cowtown Pools reported back about the heater needing to be replaced and that it was not covered due to the freeze. They never checked the freeze sensor. The report was given back to One Guard who denied the repair. When I called Cowtown to get a copy of what they said and the pictures the tech took, they would not return calls. So I called back several times. They were obviously screening their calls. After several days of this, I had a friend call and they promptly returned his call. While on the phone Cowtown set another appointment to come back out to look at the freeze sensor. Within the next couple of days Cowtown canceled the apt.  According to Cowtown Pools, One Guard Home Warranty canceled the service. When speaking with One Guard Home Warranty, they said I had canceled it. Cowtown then told One Guard I had been harassing them and they did not want to work with me.

My biggest issue is not getting a straight answer and them dodging my calls when I followed up. It is not Cowntown's fault that the One Guard does not want to do the repair. What is their fault is that they did not check the freeze sensor, which my wife specifically mentioned was the issue. If Cowtown had checked the freeze sensor and then sent me a report on their findings with the photos the tech took after the service call, I would have nothing to complain about.
reviews.author: Brooks Sommer

reviews.text: Best pool cleaners and consultants in the business. Ace is the owner and he will take the time to make sure that all of your needs are met quickly.  They also do repair and improvement work with better rates and service than anyone else that I compared to.
reviews.author: Josh Turner

reviews.text: I hired Cowtown Pools for a full remodel job on a 17 year old pool.  I am very happy with their work and the finished product.  It took about a month to do the full job but I have a 45,000 gallon pool and we had a few rain delays.  Overall, I am very pleased with their work and would hire them again for any of my pool repair needs.
reviews.author: Riley Lemmon

reviews.text: I love my pool.  It took a little longer to build than expected, but worth the wait.
reviews.author: Janice Roecker Wood

reviews.text:
I had an appointment set up, through my home warranty, to correct an overheated pump. They came out, seemingly corrected that as the pump was running when they left, however, shortly after, I noticed that the pump housing was leaking... I attempted to call the company back, several times with no return call or confirmation.
Finally, the 3rd time I called, left a voicemail, they scheduled an appointment based on my voicemail, but didn't confirm it was a good time for me with a callback or anything, simply sent an email with the time.
The technician arrived for the follow up appointment, I let him in the back to show him the issue of the leaking pump housing after the first time he came out to correct the overheated pump issue.
I explained that I was working from home, so to let me know if he needs anything. Next thing I know, he's just gone.
I didn't get an explanation, if the issue was resolved, or if he couldn't find anything or any explanation at all really.
Communication is the most important thing in doing business and I can't seem to get any.
I eventually just called my home warranty back to get another service provider. I wouldn't recommend this company to ANYONE.
reviews.author: Amanda Contella

reviews.text:
We recently had a pool installation with Cowtown Pools
and was happy from day one to finish.  Ace and Jason was here everyday
overseeing the project and the only major negative was the digging.
They were very detailed in the plans and scheduling for both ourselves
and their contractors.  This was our first installation so of course I
was a nervous wreck and they both were very patient and answered all of
my questions and text even after work as well as Madeline sending me
emails for updates.

I have three dogs and Ace went out and bought the orange safety net to
keep them safe while re-bar and holes were exposed. The whole project
took right at a month and his contractors were awesome and extremely
detailed.  We have a fresh water pool that is about 33X18 with a raised
hot tub and waterfall.

Finally, once the pool was complete, Ace gave me and my Husband a "pool school" course on how to operate the equipment and remote which good to know however we are still going to use Cowtown Pools for our weekly cleaning.

It was fun and exciting to watch the entire process from the first day
of dig to the last day when we started filling the pool!!!

WE LOVE LOVE it!   Cowtown Pools takes personal pride in their work
and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for pool installation.
reviews.author: Mary Chism-Ferguson

reviews.text: I’ve used Cowtown Pools for several years and they’ve done a good job. However, since November, 2023, they started overcharging me by billing my credit card multiple times per month instead of once! They credited my card and got my account straightened out by March, 2024. BUT, Today I checked my credit card bill and they billed me in excess TEN times since June, charging me SEVEN times in August alone! I’ve already overpaid by $635 and another $1477 would have come due due 9/10/24! Total overcharges frim June through August of $2110.90! Fortunately my credit card company is handling the slate of disputed charges AGAIN (as they did last March). I’ve contacted them repeatedly and this is the final straw. I’m 70 years old and on a fixed income! I had to liquidate some assets to pay for routine home maintenance in June which wouldn’t have been necessary if they hadn’t billed and received $635 excess payments due to 3 multiple/redundant/extra monthly charges in May and June. I have to fire them and I cannot recommend them. Caveat Emptor!
reviews.author: trayce foster

reviews.text: Cowtown repaired our pool and did a fantastic job!
reviews.author: Cory Carver

reviews.text: Cowtown Pools built and maintains our pool. We have been completely satisfied with the results. Cowtown Pools is family owned and operated. I have never had a problem contacting them for questions about the pool. Great service and follow up. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Michael Sharp

reviews.text:
They had given great service for the most part but now they’ve disappeared on our weekly pool service and not responded for going on three weeks. I also paid for this month and would like a refund. I can’t get a hold of them by text, phone, or email. They were fantastic last year but the year before that there was a period of about four weeks where they disappeared like this in the middle of summer. They came back saying they had been on vacation. What company goes on vacation (during peak pool season) and doesn’t leave someone in charge for customer assistance? I just don’t get it because most of the time they were excellent.
Edit to add: Oh and now I find out my pump is cracked and they didn’t even tell me. Communication fixes almost all problems. I wish they had been upfront and honest with me instead of just disappearing.
reviews.author: Anna F.

reviews.text:
Cowtown Pools is the best!  I own an aging in-ground pool and have had multiple pool companies work on our equipment over the years and have not been happy with much of the work.

I recently reached out to Cowtown Pools based on their BBB and other reviews.   Wow - what a find!  They did a major overhaul on my filter and heater a few months ago, and now fixing a pump problem and pool cleanup after our pool was flooded.  Very professional, competitively priced, they were on-time, cleaned up before they left,,, and work is impeccable.  Head pressure on my pump is the lowest since we've owned the house ~ 20 years, pool has been sparkling clear (and now again after the flood) - equipment working better than ever.  Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Randy “RJ” Kasper

reviews.text: This company is unreal. Came through AHS. The guy (which I suspect was on something) looks at my pool equipment. Pump leaking and inside filter putting DE in pool (per fault reported to AHS) promises me to get back in a few days to fix the leak (drops like 1Gallon a minute) and filter-  just need an OK from AHS. Nothing happens. I call Cowtown like 20-25 times during a few days, leave messages at their call service and regular voice mails. NO RESPONSE. I escalate to AHS and they state that the repair was declined as the backwash value was broken?!!?! Which were not the case why they were called. the pool guy noticed the broken handle on my backwash, but that wasn't the problem!!! So now my case is declined, can't get the hold of cowtown and had to get another pool company to fix the normal wear and tear problem...  bad company...
reviews.author: Johnny Dims

reviews.text: My home warranty uses this vendor. Terrible service. Poor communication. Did not fix anything. I had to call and ask if they fixed the problem and schedule another appointment so they can come back and fix the problem. Not really sure why they didn't fix it the first time they came out. They never returned any of my calls. I would just receive an automated text of the appointment time that was never arranged with me. They never called when they came out so I can meet them at the house. And never followed up. I still have an issue with my pool. Will never use them again and recommend you don't either.
reviews.author: M Thompson

reviews.text:
UNRELIABLE IN and OUT IN 3 mins for warranty

Claim for cracked filter. Rep shows up took one pic and said this is all I need. Asked don’t you want to open the filter? Don’t need to, see this all the time. I even offered to give him my pics. Not needed. Then submits report that I did not provide access to see damage. Claim was denied, tried reaching them and after 5 calls and messages refuse to do any business with them.
reviews.author: G Villanueva

reviews.text: I had this company come to my residence 5 times. They kept being dispatched through my home warrant company. I have a leak in my pool pump/motor which the tech could not find. I had to point it out to him. Tech does not take unit apart to diagnose this issue only assumes the issue of a gasket that is melt. He says he does not have the part in his van and he will have to order it. Later that day I get an email from my warranty company that stated my claim as been denied because of the tech recommendation to them. He said that my water was low and it caused the motor to overheat and melt the gasket. I can’t have low water because i have an automatic fill on my pool. He also did not even go around the corner to look at my pool. Only the pool equipment. If this company would make it right I’ll edit my review. However I can’t get a call back as of now…
reviews.author: Travis Flowers

reviews.text: Cade (or Kade?) not sure, made his first visit to our pool this afternoon, and I could not be happier with the time and effort he put into getting it clean. He went above and beyond and adjusted our return jets to get our Zodiac pool cleaner back working.  Highly recommend Cow Town Pools for your pool maintenance.
reviews.author: Justin Griffith

reviews.text: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!! WARNING! WORST customer service, rude people. They NEVER answer the phone called for 9 days through our home warranty.  They wouldn't answer text even though they did first time. Our pool has turned green waiting on them and they never had the decency to let us know any update on ordering parts or when they would be back out to do repairs. IF YOU LOVE WAITING AND BEING IGNORED definitely call them.  I have NEVER dealt with any company like this EVER. Please call BREAKAWAY POOLS OR GHOLKE POOLS WHO ANSWERS THEIR PHONES ALL THE TIME AND WILL COME OUT IN TIMELY MANNER about 2 days versus 5 with cow patties.  WITH BUSY LIVES THIS IS JUST DESPICABLE DISRESPECT TO CUSTOMERS. NEVER EVER AGAIN. If you have a warranty company YOU CAN REQUEST A DIFFERENT COMPANY TO DO WORK. Hope no one has to deal with these people.
reviews.author: Salt Life

reviews.text: I really feel Ace was trying to be fair and do right by us the entire time. My pool is repaired and for less cost than we expected. I was very pleased and I'm going to be a repeat customer, I have already scheduled a filter clean!
reviews.author: S L

The company has a long history (23 years) and dedicated long-term customers, but recent years show significant operational problems: poor communication, billing errors, and unsatisfactory service through home warranty programs. The A+ BBB rating contrasts with mediocre customer review scores, indicating good complaint resolution but potentially declining service quality.

Refusal to honor warranty implied in complaints

Varied writing styles and emotional tones
Mix of long-term loyalty and recent complaints
Mentions of specific employees (Ace, Maddy, Jason)
Both praise and detailed criticism present
